script: waitstop(){ for q; do /bin/sh -c 'while [ -e /proc/$1/stat ]; do read a b s r < /proc/$1/stat; [ "$s" = T ] && exit; sleep 0.001; done' sh "$q"; done; }; o=$(mktemp); set -m; /bin/sh -c 'kill -STOP $$; sleep 0.3; exit 7' & p=$!; waitstop "$p"; jobs -s >"$o"; echo S1=$(wc -l <"$o"); kill -CONT %1; jobs -r >"$o"; echo R=$(wc -l <"$o"); jobs -s > "$o"; echo S2=$(wc -l <"$o"); wait %1; echo OBS=$?; rm -f "$o"

script: waitstop(){ for q; do /bin/sh -c 'while [ -e /proc/$1/stat ]; do read a b s r < /proc/$1/stat; [ "$s" = T ] && exit; sleep 0.001; done' sh "$q"; done; }; d=$(mktemp -d); set -m; /bin/sh -c 'trap "echo trapped > \"$1/t\"; exit 5" TERM; kill -STOP $$; while :; do sleep 0.01; done' sh "$d" & p=$!; waitstop "$p"; kill %1; i=0; until [ -e "$d/t" ] || [ $i -ge 500 ]; do sleep 0.01; i=$((i+1)); done; cat "$d/t" 2>/dev/null || echo missing; kill -KILL "$p" 2>/dev/null; wait %1 >/dev/null 2>&1; rm -rf "$d"
